package org.uma.evolver.example.training.dtlz
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    AsyncGeneticAlgorithmOptimizingNSGAIIForBenchmarkDTLZ
    Class for running an asynchronous Genetic Algorithm as meta-optimizer to configure DoubleNSGAII using the DTLZ problems as training set.
    AsyncNSGAIIOptimizingNSGAIIForBenchmarkDTLZ
    Runs an asynchronous multi-threaded NSGA-II as meta-optimizer to configure NSGA-II using the DTLZ1-DTLZ7 (three-objective) problems as training set, through TrainingRunner.
    AsyncNSGAIIOptimizingPAESForBenchmarkDTLZ
    Class for running NSGA-II as meta-optimizer to configure DoublePAES using the DTLZ problems as training set.
    NSGAIIOptimizingMOPSOForBenchmarkDTLZ
    Class for running NSGA-II as meta-optimizer to configure BaseMOPSO using the DTLZ problems (3 objectives) as training set.
    NSGAIIOptimizingSMSEMOAForProblemDTLZ3
    Class for running NSGA-II as meta-optimizer to configure DoubleSMSEMOA using problem DTLZ3 as training set.
    RandomSearchOptimizingNSGAIIForBenchmarkDTLZ
    Runs Random Search as meta-optimizer to configure NSGA-II using the DTLZ1-DTLZ7 (three-objective) problems as training set, through TrainingRunner.
    SPEA2OptimizingNSGAIIForProblemDTLZ3
    Runs SPEA2 as meta-optimizer to configure NSGA-II using problem DTLZ3 (three-objective) as training set, through TrainingRunner.
